display.purpose: Upright Inter/Noto title: 32px default, 30px below 1300px, 26px below 720px and in desktop windows at or below 650px height. Short 600-959px windows at <=560px height use 22px.

title.purpose: 19px/680 default; 17px mobile; 15px retained reading index. Native original-page link.

body.purpose: Default interface body scale and bundled variable font stack.

summary.purpose: 15px/1.8 desktop summary, 14px on mobile; measured expansion, two lines; 13px in the reading index. Available expansion occupies a separate control column with an 8px gap.

control.purpose: 15px/600 primary and secondary controls; local collection variants define their own sizes.

source.purpose: 13px/500 source identity, independent from the title and record actions.

tag.purpose: 13px/1.5 record tags, status and folder paths. Dates and summary-basis captions remain 11px.

reading.purpose: 18px/1.85 article text on an opaque content surface.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Reader, dialogs and raised menus, light theme.

shadows.name: sheet-dark
shadows.purpose: Reader, dialogs and raised menus, dark theme.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Local record hover depth; the record itself is not translated.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared CSS easing for light, controls and drawer movement.

motion.name: capsule-sweep
motion.purpose: Primary/secondary hover highlight; no transition for reduced motion.

motion.name: source-medallion
motion.purpose: Local source emblem feedback; no reduced-motion transform.

motion.name: record-glint
motion.purpose: Mouse-only pointer light owned by BookmarkCard; absent under reduced motion.

motion.name: selection-plate
motion.value: GSAP width/height/x/y; 340ms power3.out; no scale projection
motion.purpose: Last painted bounds resume rapid reversals within the app. Resizing and reduced motion update the endpoint immediately.

motion.name: record-layout
motion.purpose: Motion position layout for cards; layout disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: record-arrival
motion.purpose: Initial card arrival; immediate visible endpoint under reduced motion.

motion.name: checkbox-fill
motion.purpose: Native checkbox's local fill. Checkmark uses opacity 150ms and scale 240ms; it does not draw a stroke.

motion.name: folder-face
motion.value: Matching SVG path topology and paper y: -1.5px; 240ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1)
motion.purpose: Selection or disclosure opens the folder; reduced motion uses immediate endpoints.

motion.name: overlay-enter
motion.value: opacity 200ms; y/scale spring(stiffness: 380, damping: 30); dialog y 28px, scale 0.94; menu y -10px, scale 0.97
motion.purpose: Presence-owned dialog/menu arrival; no spatial entrance under reduced motion.

motion.name: overlay-exit
motion.purpose: Visual exit only; OverlayMotion marks closing content inert and blocks pointer input immediately.

motion.name: content-arrival
motion.value: page 340ms/18px; settings section 320ms/20px; directory category 280ms/18px; pagination 340ms/22px; filter 250ms/8px; power3.out
motion.purpose: Existing GSAP controller resumes interrupted painted state and clears transform/opacity/filter after completion.

motion.name: navigation-drawer
motion.purpose: Navigation layer opening; transitions/animation removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: reader-drawer
motion.purpose: Narrow-layout reader; x is 0 and duration 0 under reduced motion.

motion.name: theme-reveal
motion.purpose: Native view transition when supported and motion is allowed; no default root crossfade.

motion.name: folder-disclosure
motion.purpose: Independent nested branch disclosure. Closing content becomes inert immediately; reduced motion has zero duration.

motion.name: startup-track
motion.purpose: Waiting state only. Motion stops for reduced motion; native error preserves retry and error details.

breakpoints.name: wide

breakpoints.name: compact-desktop

breakpoints.name: reader

breakpoints.name: short-narrow-workbench

narrative.overview:
An upright, tactile collection system uses mist-blue surroundings, porcelain reading surfaces and deep ink, with electric-blue actions. Translucent navigation and directory layers, rounded cards and molded capsule controls carry the current implementation's visual character. This is a working implementation description, not a user-approved visual identity.

On 2026-10-24 the user described PR #44's mist-blue workspace as a substantial improvement and requested comprehensive refinement. Keep its composition, typography and material direction while fixing malformed selected capsules, black control states, interrupted motion, nested-folder access and unfinished startup flows. This feedback does not approve every individual visual choice or the new refinements.

Revision 831dcfd passed all four cloud workflows with verified-source renders and installed icon evidence. Manual frame review found a shrinking category capsule during cleanup despite scale=1; the current lifecycle guard, explicit DOMRect coordinate copy and minimum-frame-dimension checks await new source-matched runs. Earlier application revision 04ecc11 and capture-only revision 7d2abd0 passed their recorded cloud checks; those runs are the historical baseline, not verification of this diff. The [current round record](docs/collection-workspace-polish-2026-10-24.md) records the implemented changes and actual check scope.
keyCharacteristics: Mist-blue ambient light, translucent supporting layers and opaque content surfaces.
Bundled Inter and Noto Sans SC with upright headings and readable mixed-language records.
Capsule controls, layered cards and motion tied to actual navigation, selection and reading state.
Independent original links, record actions and scope controls remain visible.

rules.name: Content Surface
rules.body: Keep reading text on an opaque content surface; ambient gradients and frosted layers belong to the surrounding workspace and controls.

rules.name: Motion Ownership
rules.body: Assign each animated property to its existing component or motion controller; local hover light must not translate the whole record hit area.

rules.name: Evidence Boundary
rules.body: Describe source and runtime evidence at their actual scope. A passing test or a design record never establishes user visual acceptance.

dos: Do use the current paired light and dark tokens and component-owned capsule styles.
Do preserve native links, keyboard activation, form behavior, focus return and explicit action scopes.
Do keep long Chinese and English content readable, with measured summary expansion and independent directory scrolling.
Do remove replaced styles at their owner and keep reduced-motion states usable.
Do review the new source in cloud renders and recordings with isolated synthetic data.
donts: Don't restore rejected pale-iris, limestone or pale-green layouts and tokens from historical records.
Don't use a blanket button/input appearance rule or a document-wide event patch to create local effects.
Don't merge record hover movement with the layout controller or hide metadata until hover.
Don't treat old evidence, generated tonal ramps or static component specimens as current runtime or aesthetic approval.
